paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the Micro-F1 scores of two methods, MatDetector (ours) and ChemDataExtractor, as a function of the λ value, which ranges from 'w/o' to 3 on the x-axis and is labeled "λ value". The y-axis represents the "Micro-F1 Score (%)" and spans from 52% to 58%. The MatDetector (ours) scores are plotted with a solid magenta line and magenta circular markers, while the ChemDataExtractor scores are plotted with a dashed dark blue line and dark blue square markers. At the start, when λ is 'w/o', both methods have a Micro-F1 score of approximately 53%. As λ increases to 0.2, the MatDetector score drops to about 52.7%, while the ChemDataExtractor score remains near 53%. The MatDetector score then rises to a peak of 54.1% at λ=0.3, followed by a decline to 53.1% at λ=0.4, then stabilizes near 53.2% until λ=0.6. The MatDetector score then increases again, reaching a peak of 57.9% at λ=1.0, before sharply declining to 53.4% at λ=2.0 and ending at 53.3% at λ=3.0. The ChemDataExtractor score remains relatively stable throughout, hovering around 54.5% to 55.2%, with a slight dip to 54.0% at λ=0.3 and a minor peak at λ=0.9 before gradually declining to 54.2% at λ=3.0.
